Skeletal muscle
Different types of muscle will use different fuels, mostly
fatty acids and glucose, with some metabolism of
branched chain amino acids. In starvation most
muscles can use ketone bodies.
Cardiac muscle
Mainly fatty acids, but during the absorptive period can
use lactate or glucose. During starvation ketone
bodies also may be used.
Red blood cells
Since these cells lack mitochondria they are only able to
use glucose which is fermented to lactate via
glycolysis.
Kidney
Can use most fuels but also is able to carry out
gluconeogenesis.
